comment: The keys of locales/en.json in each stable release that downloadable packs still serve, taken from
`git show v<version>:locales/en.json`. Installed apps merge the packs on main over their own bundled English,
so every key listed here has to stay in every pack, current or retired, for as long as a pack can be
installed on that release. tests/unit/locale-pack-manifest.test.js enforces it. Add the new release at each
stable release; drop one only after minAppVersion has moved past it. See "Language packs" in CONTRIBUTING.md.
